children.value: > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried told Wang to stall the US lawyers and transfer the funds to Bahamanian regulators, who were more likely to let him stay in control of the company, Wang testified.
> > Fact From Story: On November 12th, Bankman-Fried directed Wang to send customer funds to Bahamanian regulators, Wang said.
> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried believed the Bahamian regulators were more likely to let him stay in control of the company.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People want to stay in control of their company.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People in control of a company can direct the actions of employees.
> Fact From Story: On November 12th, Bankman-Fried directed Wang to send customer funds to Bahamanian regulators, Wang said.
> > Fact From Story: At the time, customers couldn’t take their funds off the exchange because FTX had run out of money and its servers had been shut down.
> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried and his father met with lawyers while Wang waited outside with liquidators.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People meet with lawyers to discuss legal strategies and options.

> > Commonsense Knowledge: Directing funds to regulators instead of customers, when customers can't access their money, suggests an attempt to maintain control rather than prioritize customer repayment.
> Commonsense Knowledge: People in control of a company can direct the actions of employees.
